subject: Encord / Lin (Wyze)
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well. Just read through a few articles highlighting Wyze's
latest AI innovations-I love the descriptive alerts feature. I couldn't
help but notice some overlaps with a few teams we are working with in the
